moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lp-wobble, written here): Each element gets x, y and rotation from slow smooth noise: recipe noise(t x 0.5), +-2 px and +-1 deg, looping every 4 s. Demo (3 squares 48 px): x, y +-5 px (noise at 1.2 t and 1.4 t), rotation +-0.2 rad, a different seed per element. Params: amp (±2 px / ±1°) · loop (4 s) · seed. Smooth noise made of three sines with whole cycles per loop, a different seed per element, so it loops seamlessly.
